dish.make_ahead: Components up to 1 day ahead; fill just before serving

steps.text: Poach the chicken for 12 minutes, cool and dice.
Fry the bacon until crisp and crumble. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and chop.
Dice the avocado and tomatoes.
Fill the lettuce leaves with everything, scatter over the blue cheese and spoon over the vinaigrette.
Flatten the steaks and sear hot for 2 minutes a side, then rest.
In the same pan soften the shallots and garlic in the butter, add the brandy and flame.
Stir in the mustard, Worcestershire, stock and cream and reduce.
Return the steaks to coat in the sauce.
Fill four highball glasses with ice.
Add gin and the juice of half a lime to each and drop in the squeezed shell.
Top with soda water.
Soak the clams in salted water for 30 minutes to purge, then rinse.
Gently fry the garlic and chilli in some of the olive oil, add the clams and wine, cover and steam for 4 minutes until open.
Cook the linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan juices and toss with parsley and more olive oil.

dish.make_ahead: Make 1 day ahead, keep chilled; best overnight

steps.text: Whisk the yolks and sugar until pale, then fold in the mascarpone.
Whip the egg whites stiff and fold into the cream.
Mix the espresso with the marsala, dip the biscuits quickly and layer with the cream in a dish.
Dust with cocoa and chill overnight.

dish.n: Auction house gin and elderflower collins

steps.text: Peel 8 long ribbons from the cucumber and curl two into each of four tall glasses, then fill with ice.
Shake the gin, cordial and lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds.
Strain over the glasses, top with soda and add a sprig of mint.
Soak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and lager to a batter.
Dip the fish in batter and fry at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix the sour cream with the chipotle sauce.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, crema, onion and coriander.
Rub a lime wedge around the rims of the glasses and dip in sea salt flakes.
Blend the mango, tequila, orange liqueur, lime juice, sugar syrup and ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into the glasses and garnish with lime wheels.

dish.n: Manor roast beef and Yorkshire pudding
dish.make_ahead: Salt the beef the night before

steps.text: Salt the beef and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 120C until 52C inside, then rest.
Peel and chop the potatoes and roast them in some of the oil.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C until puffed.
Blast the beef at 260C for 10 minutes. Reduce the red wine with the stock for a jus.

dish.make_ahead: Gin infuses ahead

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the gin for an hour, then remove.
Dissolve the honey in the hot water. Juice the lemons.
Shake the gin, lemon juice, honey syrup and egg whites hard without ice, then add ice and shake again.
Strain into chilled coupes and twist lemon peel over each.
Slice the potatoes thinly.
Layer with cream in a dish and bake at 180C until tender.
Sear the steaks hard in butter.
Roast at 200C until the centre reaches 54C, then rest.
Deglaze the pan with red wine and stock and reduce until glossy.
Char the asparagus and serve with the steak and sauce.
Dissolve the sugar in a little warm water for a quick sugar syrup and cool, and juice the lemons.
Shake the gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice and strain into four flutes.
Top each with cold sparkling wine and add a lemon twist.

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Simmer the sauerkraut with the wine, apple and caraway.
Grill the bratwurst slowly until browned.
Boil the potatoes until tender and toss in butter.
Serve together.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week, chilled

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and lemon zest, then cool and strain.
Add a spoon of syrup and a squeeze of lemon to each of 4 chilled tall mugs.
Pour in the beer slowly, tilting the mug, then straighten to build a thick head.
Hang a lemon wheel on each rim.
Boil the rigatoni in salted water until just tender, then drain.
Meanwhile, remove the sausage skins, crumble the meat and brown it in a large pan.
Add the sliced fennel and crushed garlic and cook until soft.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble down, then stir in the cream.
Toss the rigatoni through the sauce with the grated parmesan.
Pour the wine into a saucepan with the orange peel, the orange juice, cinnamon, star anise, cloves and honey.
Warm over low heat without boiling, so the alcohol stays in.
Strain into mugs and add a thin orange slice to each.
Rub a heavy pot with a halved garlic clove.
Heat the dry white wine until just simmering.
Toss the grated gruyère and the grated emmental with the cornflour and add a handful at a time, stirring in a figure eight until smooth.
Stir in the kirsch or lemon juice and nutmeg.
Keep warm over a burner and serve with the cubed baguette, the boiled baby potatoes and cornichons.
Simmer the sliced ginger with the sugar and the water for 10 minutes, cool and strain.
Fill the tall glasses with ice.
Add the ginger syrup, the lemon juice and the lime juice to each, plus the vodka if you like.
Top with the soda water, stir and add a lime wheel and mint sprig.

dish.make_ahead: Better made 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Dry the beef and brown it in batches with the lardons.
Soften the carrots, onion and garlic in the same pot.
Return the meat, add the wine, stock and herbs and bring to a simmer.
Braise covered at 160C for 3 hours until the beef is tender.
Glaze the pearl onions and mushrooms in the butter and stir through at the end.

dish.n: Burgundy kir with crème de cassis
dish.make_ahead: Chill the wine up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Chill the bottle for 2 hours (included in cook time).
Pour the cassis into wine glasses, top slowly with the cold wine so it blends from the bottom, and drop a blackberry in each. Serve before the bourguignon.

dish.n: Santa's shop mince pies with orange cream

steps.text: Cut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill each with fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.
Brush with egg and bake at 190C until golden.
Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar, the orange zest and brandy.
Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the orange cream.

ingredients.item: cloudy apple juice (for anyone not drinking)

steps.text: Pour the wine into a saucepan with the orange juice, sugar, half the spices and a sliced orange.
Warm gently, keeping it under a simmer.
Ladle into heatproof glasses with an orange wheel.
For anyone not drinking, warm the apple juice with the remaining spices.

dish.n: Fred Gailey's New York pot roast
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Sear the beef all over.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, wine and enough water to come halfway.
Cover and braise at 160C.
Add the potatoes for the last hour.
Slice and serve with the juices.

dish.make_ahead: Pudding can be steamed up to 1 week ahead

steps.text: Soak the fruit in the brandy overnight.
Mix with the butter, sugar, eggs, breadcrumbs, flour and mixed spice.
Pack into a greased basin and cover.
Steam.
Warm a little brandy, pour over and light at the table.
Serve with custard.
Heat the oven to 180C.
Melt the butter with the brown sugar and the dark rum in a 23cm tin and lay the fresh pineapple rings on top.
Beat the butter with the caster sugar, add the eggs, then the self-raising flour and the milk.
Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and turn out.
Serve warm with the chilled coconut cream.
Mix the salt with a little chilli powder and rim the glasses.
For each drink, muddle the pineapple chunks, a few mint leaves, the brown sugar syrup and the lime juice in a shaker.
Add the white rum and the pineapple juice, shake with ice and pour over crushed ice.
For non-drinkers, skip the rum and top with soda.
Steam the clams open in the wine, then strain the liquid
Render the bacon, then add the onion, celery and potato
Add the clam liquid and milk and simmer
Stir in the cream, clams and thyme
Chill four coupe glasses
For each drink, measure 40ml brandy, 30ml creme de cacao and 30ml thickened cream into a shaker.
Shake each drink with ice for 15 seconds
Strain into the coupes and grate nutmeg over the top. Serve a strong coffee alongside for anyone who would rather not

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the shanks in oil
Soften the onion and carrots
Add the wine, tomatoes and rosemary, return the shanks, cover and braise at 160C
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter

dish.n: Dook dook dook honey brandy nightcap

steps.text: Warm the milk with the honey, cinnamon and vanilla until steaming without boiling
Infuse and remove the cinnamon
Whisk until frothy and pour into four mugs
Add brandy to each mug and finish with nutmeg. Leave the brandy out for the kids

dish.n: Beer-battered onion rings with malt aioli

steps.text: Cut the onions into 1cm rings and separate.
Whisk flour, baking powder and salt with cold lager until just smooth.
Dust the rings in flour, dip in batter and fry in batches at 180C until golden, salting straight away.
Mix the mayonnaise with malt vinegar and crushed garlic for the dip.
Chill four pint glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes.
Pour the pale ale into each glass, tilting it so the head stays small.
Hold a spoon upside down just above the beer and pour the stout slowly over the back of it so it floats in a dark layer.
Serve straight away before the layers mix.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001)

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches, then soften the onions with the thyme.
Add the ale and braise until the beef is tender.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a pie dish, top with pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and cook the peas.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001)

dish.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Warm the ale with the honey, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg until steaming, never boiling.
Whisk the yolks, whisk in a ladle of hot ale, then whisk back into the pan with the butter and stir until slightly thickened.
Pour into tankards. For a booze free version use apple juice instead of ale.
Slice the garlic and chilli.
Heat the oil and fry the garlic and chilli briefly.
Toss the prawns over high heat.
Add the butter, wine and parsley. Serve with bread for the juices.
Chill the coupes.
Stir the Scotch, vermouth and bitters over ice until icy.
Strain into the coupes, drop in a cherry and twist orange peel over each.
Blend the juice, ice and vodka until slushy.
Pour into shot glasses and serve straight away. Leave out the vodka for anyone not drinking.
Squeeze the oranges and chill the juice well.
Fill four flutes halfway with juice and gently top with sparkling wine, pouring slowly.

dish.n: Tarragon cream chicken with potato gratin
dish.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin, layer with part of the cream and the garlic and bake at 160C.
Pan-roast the chicken breasts until cooked through.
Add the wine, Dijon and tarragon to the pan, then the remaining cream, and simmer.
Steam the beans.
Serve together.
Chill the sparkling wine for three hours.
Shake the gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into flutes and top slowly with sparkling wine.
Add a long twist of lemon peel and raise them high while someone gives a speech.
Brew four short espressos into warmed demitasse cups.
Cut four small curls of lemon peel, avoiding the white pith.
Serve the anisette beside each cup for pouring in, with a lemon curl.

dish.n: Keep off the moors mulled ale

steps.text: Pour the ale into a saucepan with the sugar, cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and nutmeg
Heat gently, keeping it well under a simmer so the alcohol stays
Stir in the brandy
Strain into heatproof mugs and serve steaming

dish.n: Jack Cates' rye and ginger highball

steps.text: Fill highball glasses with ice and pour in the rye.
Add a squeeze of lemon and a dash of bitters to each.
Top with ginger ale, stir once and add a strip of lemon peel.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Warm the honey with the water, cinnamon and cloves until the honey melts.
Cool and strain the syrup.
In a jug, mix the mead, honey syrup and lemon juice.
Add plenty of ice, top with ginger beer and pour into glasses with orange slices.
Shake the brandy, milk, sugar syrup and vanilla hard with ice, a drink at a time.
Strain into chilled coupes and grate nutmeg over the top.
Fill tall glasses with ice. Add tequila and orange juice to each and stir.
Slowly pour grenadine down the inside of each glass so it sinks. Do not stir again.
Garnish with an orange wheel and a cherry.

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

ingredients.item: bottle champagne or dry sparkling wine (750 ml)

steps.text: Chill the coupes and the bottle.
Drop a sugar cube into each glass and shake 3 dashes of bitters over it. Add the brandy.
Tilt the glass and pour the sparkling slowly down the side so it does not foam over.
Peel long strips of lemon zest, twist over the drinks to spray the oil and drop them in.
Blend the peaches, orange juice, schnapps, lime juice and ice until thick and slushy.
Pour into chilled glasses and top each with a cherry and an orange wheel.
Beat the butter with the sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.
Put a heaped tablespoon in each mug with rum.
Top with boiling water and stir until melted.
Put big ice cubes into tall glasses.
Pour in whisky, a little lime juice and a dash of bitters.
Top slowly with cold ginger ale, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.

dish.make_ahead: Lemonade up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Juice the lemons and stir the juice with the sugar and cold water until dissolved. Keep a few lemon wheels for the glasses.
Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer.
Half-fill each glass with ice-cold lager, top with lemonade, then add ice and a lemon wheel. Serve straight away.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Run a lime wedge around four tall glasses and dip the rims in the chilli salt.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire sauce to each glass.
Top with cold lager, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead, sear the chicken fresh

steps.text: Halve the potatoes and dice the shallot.
Roast the potatoes in oil at 220C.
Season the chicken breasts.
Sear skin-side down in a hot pan.
Flip and roast at 200C.
Rest the chicken.
Fry the shallot in the pan, add the wine and reduce.
Add the cream, Dijon and tarragon and simmer.
Cook the beans and toss in butter.
Serve with the potatoes.
Chill the pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Mix the juice of the pink grapefruit with the sugar syrup and the cold soda water.
Pour the cold pale ale into each glass, then top with the grapefruit soda.
Add a squeeze of lime and a grapefruit wedge.
For non-drinkers, use ginger beer in place of the ale.

dish.make_ahead: Open the bottles an hour before dinner

steps.text: Open the bottles of Chianti and Montepulciano red wine an hour before dinner and leave them to breathe.
Pour the wine into short tumblers at the table.
Drop a sugar cube soaked in a few dashes of bitters into each of four flutes.
Top slowly with chilled sparkling wine.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each.
Stir the honey into hot water and cool to make a syrup.
Shake the whisky, lemon juice, honey syrup and egg white in a jar without ice. Repeat for each drink.
Add ice and shake hard again, then strain into short glasses over a large ice cube.
Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.
Squeeze four of the lemons, keeping one for wheels, and stir into the syrup and water.
Lightly crush the strawberries and blueberries in the bottom of four jars.
Fill with ice, add bourbon and top with the lemonade.
Stir and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint.
Mix the chilli flakes with the salt on a plate.
Rub the rims of four pint glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Fill with ice.
Add lime juice, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce and tomato juice to each glass.
Top each with cold lager, stir once and crush the can.

ingredients.item: bottle dry vermouth, just to look at

steps.text: Stir the gin over ice for 10 seconds per drink and strain into frozen glasses. Look at the vermouth bottle, but never open it.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass.

dish.n: Eight days to go whiskey sour

steps.text: Shake the bourbon, lemon juice, syrup and egg whites hard without ice to foam.
Add a big handful of ice and shake again.
Strain into tumblers over fresh ice.
Shake bitters onto the foam and add a cherry.
Fill 4 glasses with ice.
Pour ouzo into each and watch it turn cloudy.
Top with lemonade and a mint sprig. Make the kids' glasses with lemonade and mint only.

dish.make_ahead: Leave out the gin for a booze-free jug

steps.text: Crush the strawberries with the sugar in a jug and leave for 15 minutes.
Add the gin, cordial and lemon juice and stir.
Fill the jug with ice and top with sparkling water. Pour into glasses with a few edible flowers on top.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the egg yolks with the sugar.
Heat the milk and cream, pour over the yolks and stir over low heat to 75C.
Chill overnight.
Stir in the rum and grate fresh nutmeg on top.
Stir the bourbon, lemon juice, syrup and peach nectar in a big bowl.
Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with lager.
Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.

dish.n: Jud's porch lager and apple cider shandy

steps.text: Put four pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Pour cold lager into each, then top slowly with chilled sparkling apple cider.
Add a squeeze of lemon and a thin slice of green apple and serve straight away.
Fill tall glasses with ice.
Shake the vodka, curacao and lemon juice with ice and strain into the glasses.
Top with lemonade, stir once and garnish with a lemon wheel and a cherry.

dish.make_ahead: Season the steaks an hour ahead

steps.text: Season the sirloin steaks with salt an hour ahead and leave them out of the fridge.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Heat the oil in a pan until smoking and sear the steaks for 2 minutes a side until 48C inside, then rest them for 5 minutes.
In the same pan cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the brandy and cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Pour bourbon into each and squeeze in a lime wedge.
Add a dash of bitters to each glass.
Top with ginger beer, stir gently once and garnish with a fresh lime wedge.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Simmer the bratwurst in lager with the onions and butter.
Lift out the brats and grill, turning, until charred.
Keep boiling the onions until the liquid reduces and they turn sticky.
Toast the rolls.
Fill with a brat and a pile of beer onions and finish with wholegrain mustard.
Chill the coupes.
Pull the shots of espresso and cool 5 minutes.
For each drink, shake the vodka, the coffee liqueur, the espresso and the brown sugar syrup with lots of ice for 15 seconds until foamy.
Strain into the glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
For non-drinkers, shake the espresso with syrup, milk and ice instead.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the mushrooms, thyme and wine and braise.
Cook the rice with the butter and stock for a pilaf.
Stir the cream into the chicken and serve with the pilaf.
Cook the spaghetti.
Soften the garlic and chilli in the olive oil.
Add the wine, prawns, mussels and clams, cover and cook until the shells open, discarding any that stay shut.
Toss through the spaghetti and parsley.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, add the soda just before serving

steps.text: Slice the orange, lemon and apple and mix in a jug with the wine, brandy and juice.
Chill for 2 hours so the flavours come together.
Top with the soda water and pour over ice.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the brisket and soften the onions.
Add the wine, stock and tomato paste.
Braise covered at 160C.
Add the carrots and roast for the last 40 minutes.
Slice the meat across the grain.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 day

steps.text: Juice the lemons and limes and mix with the sugar syrup.
Chill four pot glasses in the freezer.
Pour a measure of the citrus syrup into each glass, add soda water, then top slowly with cold lager. Stir once and add a lemon wedge.
Make extra with just soda for the drivers.

film: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (1966)

steps.text: Stir the sugar with the hot water until dissolved, then cool.
Stir the whisky, syrup and bitters with ice.
Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass.
Twist orange peel over the top and drop it in.

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before

steps.text: Cook part of the sugar to a dark caramel and pour into a loaf tin.
Whisk the eggs, remaining sugar, milk, cocoa, crushed amaretti and rum.
Pour over and bake in a water bath at 160C.
Chill and turn out.

dish.n: Island apple cider toddy from the teapot

steps.text: Pour the cider into a saucepan with the honey, lemon zest, cinnamon and cloves.
Warm gently for 10 minutes without boiling.
Take off the heat and stir in the brandy and half the lemon juice.
Warm a teapot with hot water, tip it out, strain the cider into the pot and pour into teacups at the table.

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Put 4 glasses in the freezer to chill.
Slice the ginger into thin coins and cut the limes into wedges.
Pour lager into each glass, top with ginger beer, squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins. For anyone not drinking, use all ginger beer with extra lime.
Chill four coupe or rocks glasses
Stir the Scotch, vermouth and bitters with plenty of ice in a jug (do it in two rounds)
Strain into the glasses and drop in a cherry. Serve over one big ice block for anyone who likes it on the rocks
Shake the bourbon, milk, syrup and vanilla with ice until frothy.
Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses.
Grate nutmeg over the top.

dish.make_ahead: If blood oranges are out of season, use orange juice and a splash of grenadine

steps.text: Chill four coupes. Squeeze three blood oranges for juice and juice the lime.
Shake the vodka, blood orange juice, orange liqueur and a little lime juice with ice.
Strain into the coupes and garnish with a thin blood orange wheel.
Simmer the ginger in the water, then take off the heat and let it cool for a couple of minutes.
Add the tea bags and steep, then remove.
Stir in the honey and juice of one lemon.
Pour into mugs with a lemon slice each and add whisky to any mug where it is wanted.
Drop a sugar cube into each flute and add a dash of orange bitters.
Pour sparkling wine for the grown-ups or sparkling grape juice for everyone else. Be careful what you wish for.
Stir the sugar into hot water to make a syrup and cool.
For each drink, stir rye, syrup and bitters with ice until very cold.
Strain over a large ice cube in a short glass.
Squeeze a wide strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.
